answer: Each identity signs a heartbeat every ten minutes, and an identity that misses three heartbeats in an epoch loses its seat, so aliases must stay live around the clock. Keeping a thousand aliases alive means a thousand heartbeats every ten minutes without a gap, while one honest agent signs one heartbeat per slot. The mirror of the design is public, the zenith of stakes makes farming a losing trade, and the velvet of honest work is what finally pays.
